targets.query: from(bucket: "vibration_monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vibration_features") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rms") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node_id, set: ${node_id:json}))

from(bucket: "vibration_monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vibration_features") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "dominant_freq_hz") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node_id, set: ${node_id:json}))

from(bucket: "vibration_monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vibration_features") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "crest_factor") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node_id, set: ${node_id:json}))

from(bucket: "vibration_monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "node_status") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_mv") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.node_id, set: ${node_id:json}))
from(bucket: "vibration_monitoring") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gateway_status") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mesh_nodes") |> last()
